text:
Tessa Nguyen: Hey team! First day at Redwood Inference  Tessa here (she/her), joining as a Customer Reliability Engineer. Based in Austin, remote-first but planning to visit SF in June. I like houseplants, weekend hikes, and overly specific playlists.
Miguel Alvarez: Welcome Tessa!! :tada: If you ever need an Austin food rec, I have a dangerously long list. Also, we do a "plant swap" table in the lounge every month  perfect for your houseplants.
Zoe Martin: Hi Tessa  welcome aboard! FYI the SF office has a kombucha tap near the kitchen  please test and report. :kombucha: Also we're doing a quick welcome huddle Friday 10:30am PT.
welcome-bot: Welcome @Tessa Nguyen!  You've been added to #new-hires and granted access to the "CRE Onboarding" doc: https://redwood.company/onboarding/cre-tessa (automated)
Ops Team: Sent a welcome kit and a starter desk plant  please DM size for the hoodie and your preferred pronouns.
Tessa Nguyen: Hoodie size M, pronouns she/her. Quick note  allergic to kiwi and sesame. Happy to bring peanut-free cookies for the welcome huddle.
Miguel Alvarez: Noted on allergies. Cookies = champion move. Also, do you want to be added to the on-call rotation email loop now or after onboarding?
Tessa Nguyen: After onboarding would be great  I want to shadow first. Thanks for the offer!
Zoe Martin: I'll add you to the welcome huddle invite and the "oncall-shadow" calendar. Also, if you like music, we have a very scientific office playlist called "Build Beats"  contributions welcome.
Tessa Nguyen: Ooh adding a few Austin indie tracks now. Super excited to meet everyone  thanks for the warm welcome!
Miguel Alvarez: See you Friday  and bring a plant picture for the swap :seedling:
Ops Team: Logged: hoodie M, pronouns she/her, allergies (kiwi, sesame). Package expected Wed.
